recommendation.decision: Deprioritize graph ordering and skip its 600-second loaded run for now. Retain the exact-PCM candidate as a fallback; investigate the flash-attention path next.
recommendation.basis: All 16 requests and startup costs show unchanged ordinary-profile cost without a positive efficiency signal. Matched-case compute is slightly higher in every case, while sampled profiles and clocks are comparable. The candidate's effect at 300-500 MHz remains unknown. Flash attention addresses measured attention work, but supported shapes, native arithmetic precision and numerical output must be established before any loaded test; F32 inputs alone do not prove F32 internal arithmetic.
recommendation.no_claim: This is experiment prioritization, not proof graph ordering cannot help tails or a new acceptance gate. Preserve the 4.095-second p99 target and existing model, windows and power guard; no causal superiority, memory qualification, user waiver or p99 pass follows from 16 requests.

notes: 59 native captures retain one exact PID/start identity perleg; four supervisor captures stay separate.
Observed0MHz values are retained point samples within CPU/I/O/idle portions; not a sustained low-clock inference measurement.
Only whole-infer call intervals are known. Sparse captures and their read intervals cannot prove continuous clock, temperature, power or exact GPU-phase occupancy.
Four RAPL energy files are denied on every one of63 captures (252 field-read errors); no power/energy comparison follows.
Four supervisor fdinfo read races remain recorded, native fd errors0; no process-sample or trace errors.
Capture elapsed includes reads but excludes aggregation/trace-write overhead; observed gaps include requested interval plus observer/scheduler/write effects.
Native VmHWM is CPU-resident high-water. Candidate graph-buffer bytes have no measured A equivalent and cannot be added to RSS/DRM maxima.
